sv.title: Sänker kraven på systemviktiga banker
sv.summary: Bank of England gör vissa regelförändringar som innebär lägre genomsnittliga kapitalkrav för inhemskt fokuserade systemviktiga banker.

en.title: Cuts capital requirements for systemically important banks
en.summary: The Bank of England is making certain regulatory changes that will result in lower average capital requirements for domestically focused systemically important banks.
